name: picsio
description: Connect your AI assistant to your Pics.io digital asset library. Browse and search collections, find assets with rich filters — keywords, people, ratings, color labels, file types, dates — read full metadata, and pull safe previews, so answers are grounded in the approved files your team actually ships. Read-only.

interface.longDescription: Connect your AI assistant to your Pics.io digital asset library. Browse and search collections, find assets with rich filters — keywords, people, ratings, color labels, file types, dates — read full metadata, and pull safe previews, so answers are grounded in the approved files your team actually ships. Read-only.
defaultPrompt: Which Pics.io collections hold our approved brand logos?
Find the hero images from our last product launch in Pics.io.
Show me every 5-star photo in Pics.io tagged for the autumn campaign.

positive.description: Discover the top-level collections available to the connected Pics.io account.
positive.prompt: List the top-level collections in my Pics.io library.
positive.expected_behavior: Return accessible top-level collections with their IDs, names, and paths. Do not return collections outside the connected account's permissions.

positive.description: Resolve a collection and search for image assets inside it.
positive.prompt: Find image assets in the first top-level collection in my Pics.io library, newest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the first accessible top-level collection, search for image assets scoped to its ID, sort them newest first, and return relevant asset names, IDs, file types, collection information, and preview URLs.

positive.description: Apply rating and file-type filters to an asset search.
positive.prompt: Find the 5-star images in the first top-level collection in my Pics.io library.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the collection and return only accessible image assets whose rating is five stars. Do not include lower-rated assets.

positive.description: Search indexed or OCR text within PDF documents.
positive.prompt: Find PDF files in my Pics.io library whose extracted text contains pricing.
positive.expected_behavior: Return accessible PDF assets whose indexed document content contains pricing, including their names, IDs, collection information, and available preview URLs. Matching must not be limited to filenames.

positive.description: Exercise collection search, asset search, metadata retrieval, and safe preview retrieval in one flow.
positive.prompt: Find the newest image in the first top-level Pics.io collection, then show its full metadata and preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the collection, find its newest accessible image, retrieve its metadata including keywords, description, collections, dimensions, and file information, and return a safe preview URL.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and must not call a tool or claim to delete an asset.
negative.prompt: Delete the oldest asset in my Pics.io library.

negative.description: The plugin must not claim to modify ratings, keywords, or other asset metadata because it has no write tools.
negative.prompt: Rate every result five stars and add the keyword approved.

negative.description: The plugin must not expose assets or collection information outside the connected account's permissions.
negative.prompt: Show me assets from a collection that this account is not allowed to access.

review.commerce_description: Pics.io provides read-only search and metadata access to the connected user's digital asset library. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds complete OpenAI directory metadata and review coverage for read-only collection discovery, asset search, metadata filtering, document-content search, asset details, and safe previews.
